SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

The Components Test Organization is a team of engineers, specialists, and technicians who provide the testing expertise needed to develop flight hardware for Falcon Launch Systems, Dragon Spacecraft Systems, Starship Launch and Spacecraft Systems, as well as Starlink Telecommunications Satellites.

Our responsibilities to the flight hardware start at conception and follow the design through R&D testing, design qualification testing, production/acceptance testing, and finally to failure investigations of hardware that may have failed anywhere in its life cycle.
As testing experts, we provide a critical element to the hardware development process, and need to be highly proficient in many different engineering disciplines, including electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, fluid dynamics, automation and control systems, as well as the interpretation and analysis of test data.

Because this role is largely hands-on, we also need to be experts in the safe operation of highly energetic and hazardous testing, to ensure everyone remains safe at all times.

Due to our expertise with the flight hardware, as well as its testing requirements, we are also responsible for the development of automated test systems required to produce the flight hardware, rapidly and reliably.

This requires us to be skilled in systems engineering, CAD, analysis, fabrication/build, project management, and logistics—with a focus on propulsion components like high-pressure fluid systems, valves, turbomachinery, and injectors for Starship's Raptor engines.

Fill the role of instrumentation and test expert on the flight hardware development team
Develop the detailed test plans and campaigns required to validate the flight hardware
Assist with anomaly/failure investigations
Develop requirements for new test systems needed to test and validate flight hardware
Work with a cross-discipline team including electrical, mechanical, and software engineers to conceptualize and develop new test systems required to test and validate flight hardware
Train personnel on the required processes and operations of complex test systems
Ensure all testing is conducted in compliance with all safety protocols, at all times

ABOUT US Storyteller is a high-growth B2B SaaS platform that enables companies to add Stories experiences to their own apps and websites. Stories help our clients increase engagement, retention and revenue.

Our platform combines SDKs, publishing tools, analytics and advertising support so enterprise customers can launch a complete Stories experience quickly. We work with major sports and media brands, and the experiences we power are used by large audiences around the world. About the Role This is an AI-native quality engineering role.

You will use AI as a core part of how you investigate software, build automated tests, understand unfamiliar code, diagnose failures and make changes. Your work will span the quality of SDK behaviour and the integration between Storyteller SDKs, platform services and APIs.

Storyteller has SDKs across iOS, Android, Web, tvOS, Fire TV, Android TV and Roku. The role will initially focus on iOS and Android, with opportunities to contribute across the wider SDK portfolio over time.

This is a hands-on engineering role, but not a separate QA gatekeeping function: You’ll use AI coding agents and related tools to explore the SDK codebases, understand behaviour and accelerate quality work. You’ll care about tests that protect important behaviour and run in real development and release workflows.

You’ll use product, technical, integration and release risk to identify the highest-value quality improvements. You will work as a senior individual contributor inside the Storyteller team. Quality belongs to the whole team, and you will work directly with builders and product owners throughout the product and engineering lifecycle.

Success is measured by the confidence and useful evidence the work gives the team. RESPONSIBILITIES Use AI coding agents and related tools to explore the SDK codebases, understand behaviour and accelerate quality work. Use product, technical, integration and release risk to identify the highest-value quality improvements.

Design, build and maintain useful unit and component tests for SDK behaviour. Design, build and maintain integration tests covering SDK interaction with Storyteller services and APIs. Put automated tests into active CI and release workflows, with failures that are clear and actionable.

Prove that tests detect meaningful breakage rather than merely producing passing output. Investigate bugs using code, logs, APIs, test results and product behaviour. Where appropriate, follow a well-understood issue through to a bounded production fix. Work with builders to improve testability and prevent repeated classes of defects.

Turn repeated investigation or testing work into reusable AI workflows, tools, checks or test assets. Communicate clearly in Slack and other team systems: state the evidence, impact, current understanding, owner and next action.

Contribute useful AI-assisted engineering practices to the wider SDK team while remaining primarily accountable for quality outcomes. Contribute to tvOS, Android TV, Fire TV, Web and Roku as the role's scope expands.

What Good Looks Like  You will be succeeding when:  Important SDK behaviours have dependable automated protection;  Useful quality improvements land incrementally and are easy for the team to adopt;  SDK-to-platform integration failures are detected early and are easy to diagnose;  Tests run reliably in the workflows the team actually uses;  Test failures give the team enough information to act;  Well-understood defects are followed through to an appropriate fix or clear handover;  Repeated quality problems become better tests, tooling or product changes;  Automation and risk-based exploration provide evidence proportionate to the change;  Your communication makes quality risks and next actions easy to understand;  And the Storyteller team becomes more capable with AI because of practical workflows you have demonstrated through the work.

QUALIFICATIONS What we’re looking for AI-native execution – You use AI to do substantive technical work, not only to write or summarise. You can give an agent useful context, break down an ambiguous problem, inspect its work, redirect it when necessary and keep going when the first approach fails.

Quality and validation judgment – You can decide what is worth testing, recognise superficial tests and demonstrate that an automated test provides real protection. You think about false confidence, false positives, brittle tests, maintainability and failure diagnosis.

Agency and ownership – You can take an ambiguous quality risk, investigate it, gather evidence, choose a sensible next step and move the work towards a useful outcome. Technical comfort – You are comfortable working with repositories, code, APIs, CI, logs, command-line tools and automated test frameworks.

You can understand and challenge AI-generated code well enough to validate and land it safely. Problem solving and systems thinking – You distinguish symptoms from root causes. When a problem repeats, you look for a reusable test, tool, check or workflow instead of treating every occurrence as a new manual task.

Clear communication – You communicate concisely and directly. You make evidence, impact, uncertainty, ownership and next actions visible without requiring someone else to reconstruct the situation. Learning velocity – You are curious and can become effective in unfamiliar products, codebases and tools quickly.

You change your approach when the evidence shows that it is not working. You do not need to be able to write Swift or Kotlin expertly without AI assistance, have deep experience across every Storyteller SDK platform, have held a traditional QA, test-automation or SDET title, or have managed a separate QA team.

Nice to have Experience with mobile applications or SDKs. Experience with Swift or Kotlin. Experience with API integration. Experience with automated testing or test frameworks.

These may help you become effective faster, but demonstrated AI-native execution, quality judgment and validation discipline matter more than matching a conventional technology checklist. Is this You? This role will likely suit you if: You can take an ambiguous quality risk from signal to outcome with limited supervision.

You can frame the problem, direct AI and other tools effectively, and choose a practical testing or investigation approach. You validate output rigorously, communicate what you found and land useful work. You improve the system for the next occurrence rather than treating every problem as a one-off.

You are comfortable being accountable for quality outcomes while quality remains a shared responsibility across the team. It probably isn’t right for you if: You want AI to produce technical work that you do not need to understand, explain or validate.

You prefer to wait for fully defined instructions rather than investigate ambiguous risks and choose a sensible next step. You are looking for a separate QA gatekeeping role rather than working directly with builders and product owners throughout the lifecycle. RECRUITMENT PROCESS We keep the process straightforward and respectful of your time.  1.

Hiring Manager Conversation (20–30 mins)  A short call to get to know you, share more about Storyteller and the QA Engineer role, and answer your questions. There is no technical exercise at this stage. We’ll both aim to decide whether it makes sense to go deeper 2.

Paid Take-home Task (~60 mins)  A small, focused quality-engineering task that you can complete in your own time. We compensate you for completing it, regardless of the outcome. You’re welcome to use AI tools.

Since 2018 we've been building the data foundation, and the AI agents on top of it, that let freight teams quote, book and manage rates in a fraction of the time. Today more than 30,000 users across 172 countries run on us.
Ocean is our newest frontier. We've just brought ocean freight onto the platform alongside air, in one workspace powered by the same AI, and we need people who can make that ocean data rock solid from day one.
As our Content Operations QA Analyst (Ocean) , you're the sharp eye that keeps our ocean pricing data trustworthy. Carriers and partners send us their rates, and increasingly our AI helps process them. Your job is to make sure every figure is right before it reaches a customer.

You don't need a background in shipping or logistics; we'll teach you how ocean pricing works. You'll build the expertise to spot instantly when something's been entered wrong, fix it, and close the loop with the source so it doesn't happen again.
It's a hands-on, detail-driven role for someone who takes real pride in getting things exactly right. We're backed by leading investors, including Index, Bessemer, Point Nine, Creandum and Lufthansa, and we work remote-first in a positive, feedback-driven and genuinely fun team.
🌍 Where you can work
We're remote-first. You can work from (almost) anywhere cargo.one is able to employ through our partner Remote . We're a remote company, but we regularly meet in person, too.
🎬 A snapshot of what you'll be doing here
Quality-check the ocean freight contracts, rates and surcharges that our partners and AI populate, cross-checking every entry against the source rate sheets and tariffs.
Build deep knowledge of ocean rates and surcharges, so you can immediately spot when something looks wrong.
Catch and correct errors before they reach our customers, keeping our data accurate and trustworthy.
Communicate clearly with our vendor partners when something needs fixing, and close the loop so the same mistake doesn't recur.
Spot recurring error patterns and help improve our QA checks, guides and documentation.
Use AI tools to make the QA process faster and sharper, and ideally help build them.
Maintain structured, high-quality master data across the ocean content set.

We're solving humanity's biggest challenge, and it takes everything we've got.
The world needs more energy, not less. Fossil fuels powered our economy for decades, at the cost of our planet. At Phlair, we're inverting that equation with breakthrough electrochemical Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology that pulls CO₂ from the air for permanent storage or repurposing into carbon-negative chemicals.
We're not here to play it safe. We're here to win.
Why We’re Different?
We solve hard problems and are product-first. Our hydrolyzer-based Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology, enabling scalable and low-cost CO2 capture from ambient air. The electrochemical technology allows off-the-shelf components and is ideally suited to the intermittent nature of renewable energy sources.
With proven offtake agreements from customers such as Google, McKinsey, JPMorganChase, Shopify, Stripe, H&M, and Deep Sky; we're one of only seven DAC companies with real market validation.
Project Dawn isn't just our flagship; it's our shot to scale CO₂ removal globally.
Is this a fit for me?
We're building for the 3-5% who are energized by winning and thrive under pressure. Our pace demands people who see excellence as non-negotiable and execution as everything. Ihre Aufgaben Um unser Business weiter auszubauen, suchen wir engagierte Kolleg*innen – diesmal für eine Rolle, die es bei uns so noch nie gab.
Rund um KI und Automatisierung haben wir schon einiges angestoßen – und suchen dich, um diese Schritte spürbar zu beschleunigen. Statt Tool-Wildwuchs entwickeln wir eigene integrierte Systeme auf Basis von KI und Automatisierung für Vertrieb und Operations.

Daneben wachsen KI-Assistenten, automatisierte Auswertungen aus Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn und unseren SEO-Tools sowie Reportings, die sich selbst schreiben und über Human in the Loop besser werden. Ein großer Teil der Kundenarbeit unserer über 60 Kolleg*innen ist und bleibt trotzdem Handarbeit.
Du liest eine API-Dokumentation und hast zwei Stunden später einen laufenden Prototyp? Du verstehst, warum eine SEA-Managerin anders auf Daten schaut als ein SEO – und kannst einem Kollegen ohne technischen Hintergrund erklären, wie er das Ergebnis ab morgen selbst bedient? Du denkst KI nicht als Spielerei, sondern als System, das dokumentiert, datenschutzkonform und im Betrieb stabil sein muss? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Zum Ausbau unseres AI- und Automatisierungsbereichs suchen wir dich als AI Automation Engineer – Marketing & Operations Consulting (m/w/d) .
Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI- und Automatisierungssysteme, mit denen unsere Teams täglich arbeiten – und bringst dieselbe Kompetenz in unsere Kundenprojekte ein, von Marketing-Technology-Fragen bis zur Beratung rund um Automatisierung.

Deine Arbeitsweise ist AI Engineering gepaart mit Vibe Coding: Du weißt, wie man ein System sauber aufsetzt, betreibt und absichert – und du kommst trotzdem in Tagen statt Quartalen zum lauffähigen Ergebnis, weil du KI als Werkzeug beim Bauen selbstverständlich einsetzt.

Du verbindest Werkzeuge miteinander, schaffst die Datengrundlage, auf der diese Systeme überhaupt erst sinnvoll arbeiten, und befähigst Kolleg*innen wie Kund*innen, damit zu arbeiten. So werden aus Möglichkeiten messbar eingesparte Stunden.
Infos unter www.klickpiloten.de .
Deine Aufgaben
Bauen und betreiben: Du entwickelst unsere internen KI-Systeme weiter – Assistenten, Agenten, automatisierte Workflows – vom ersten Prototyp bis in den produktiven Betrieb. Du baust selbst, mit Claude Code, Cursor oder womit auch immer du am schnellsten zum Ergebnis kommst. Und du hältst am Leben, was du gebaut hast: Monitoring, Fehlerfälle, Kosten, Qualität der Ergebnisse. Schnell gebaut heißt bei uns nicht wegwerfbar.
Systeme verbinden, Kontext schaffen: Du verdrahtest unsere Werkzeuge miteinander – Google Ads API, Meta Marketing API, SEO-Tools, unser CRM, Google Workspace, MCP-Server. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere KI-Systeme mit den richtigen Daten arbeiten. Das ist der eigentliche Hebel: Ein Modell ist nur so gut wie der Kontext, den es bekommt.
Kundenprojekte und Marketing Technology: Du berätst unsere Kund*innen zu ihrem Marketing-Technology-Stack: welche Systeme sie wirklich brauchen, wie Shop, CRM und Werbeplattformen zusammenspielen, wo Datenfeeds und Schnittstellen hingehören. Du konzipierst kundenspezifische Automatisierungen und KI-Anwendungsfälle und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unseren Fachteams um – von der Machbarkeitsfrage im Pitch bis zur Lösung, die beim Kunden läuft.
Consulting rund um Marketing und Automatisierung: Du führst Workshops bei Kund*innen durch, findest heraus, wo in deren Prozessen Zeit und Datenqualität verloren gehen, und übersetzt das in konkrete Maßnahmen. Was sich bei uns intern bewährt, entwickelst du zu einem Beratungsangebot weiter, das wir verkaufen können.
Tracking, Consent und Analytics: Du baust Tracking- und Analytics-Setups auf, bringst das Consent Management sauber dazu und konsolidierst vor allem Marketingdaten aus ihren vielen Quellen – Werbeplattformen, SEO-Tools, Shop, CRM – zu einem Bild, das trägt.

Du automatisierst, was daraus regelmäßig entstehen muss: die Präsentation, die sich aus Kampagnendaten selbst zusammenbaut, das Reporting, das Dienstagfrüh fertig im Sheet steht.

Und du bleibst nicht bei der Zahl stehen, sondern liest aus den Daten, was sie über Kampagnen, Zielgruppen und Budgets sagen, und machst daraus eine Empfehlung, mit der Teams und Kund*innen etwas anfangen können.
Qualitätschecks und Audits automatisieren: Du automatisierst unsere internen Qualitätssicherungen – Kampagnen-, Tracking- und Account-Setups werden regelmäßig maschinell geprüft, statt dass jemand Checklisten abarbeitet. Abweichungen fallen auf, bevor eine Kundin sie bemerkt. Aus wiederkehrenden Fehlerbildern machst du Regeln, die dauerhaft mitlaufen.
Enablement und Coaching: Du schulst und begleitest die Teams, fortlaufend und nah an der konkreten Arbeit statt im einmaligen Workshop. Du schreibst Playbooks, Anleitungen und Dokumentation, die auch jemand versteht, der nicht dabei war. Und du erkennst, welche Handarbeit sich zu automatisieren lohnt und welche man besser Handarbeit sein lässt.
Compliance, Datenschutz und Vertraulichkeit: Du entscheidest mit, welche KI-Anbieter und Modelle wir einsetzen und wo Kundendaten dabei landen dürfen. DSGVO, EU AI Act und unsere Vertraulichkeitszusagen bringst du in eine Form, mit der das Team im Alltag arbeiten kann. Du dokumentierst unsere Systeme so, dass sie prüfbar und übergabefähig bleiben.
Schnittstelle nach außen: Wo wir nicht selbst bauen, steuerst du externe Entwickler*innen, Dienstleister und Tool-Anbieter – von der Anforderung über die Abnahme bis zum Betrieb. Auch auf Kundenseite bist du die Person, die mit IT-Abteilungen und Technikpartnern auf Augenhöhe spricht und zwischen Marketing-Anforderung und technischer Umsetzung übersetzt.
Innovation: Du beobachtest, was sich bei Modellen, Agenten-Frameworks und Marketing-APIs bewegt, bewertest neue Features nüchtern und entscheidest, was davon bei uns Produktivbetrieb verdient – und was nicht.

Du hast in den letzten Jahren Automatisierungen oder KI-Anwendungen gebaut, die produktiv im Einsatz waren. Zeig uns zwei oder drei davon.

Digitalmarketing-Verständnis. Du weißt, was eine Kampagnenstruktur ist, was ein Sichtbarkeitsindex aussagt und warum Attribution kompliziert ist.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Software Quality Engineer to join our Mission Assurance team. This role sits at the intersection where software quality meets in-orbit operations, offering the opportunity to drive the operational performance of a satellite constellation.

The role has two facets, you will own software quality assurance activities across the development lifecycle and also provide quality oversight to the team operating our constellation of satellites during commissioning, operations, and anomaly response.

As the company implements its development roadmap, the distinction between these two aspects will blur with satellite operations increasingly transitioning to automated AI/ML tools to manage the fleet.
The ideal candidate combines a rigorous, process-driven approach to software quality with an analytical mindset and operational awareness to allow them to ensure on-orbit anomalies are investigated and resolved effectively.
This is a broad remit, so previous experience in both areas is not required. For example, a strong software QA background in a demanding industry (e.g. banking, medical, defence) will likely also have developed the analytical mindset needed to investigate on orbit issues.

You will work closely with a fantastic team of software engineers, systems engineers, technical experts and spacecraft operators to ensure that our software and satellites are fit for purpose and that deviations from expected behaviour are understood, reported, assessed, and resolved with sound engineering judgment.
What You’ll Do as Software & Satellite Operations Quality Engineer:

Define and maintain software QA processes, standards, and acceptance criteria for onboard and ground segment software across the full development lifecycle.
Ensure that software verification and validation activities are comprehensive and correctly executed.
Ensure the Software Development Lifecycle meets applicable quality requirements and standards.
Where situations require deviation from defined process, ensure that this is performed safely and in a controlled manner.
Raise, track, and manage non-conformances, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are identified and implemented effectively.
Ensure risks are identified, evaluated and communicated effectively to the project and management team.
Ensure that the software configuration baseline is maintained throughout development and mission lifetimes.
Confirm all software releases are reviewed and compliant to standards.
Contribute to process improvement initiatives and ensure compliance with applicable standards (e.g. ISO 29110, ECSS-Q-ST-80, ECSS-E-ST-40, or equivalent).

Provide Mission Assurance support to satellite operations, especially during critical mission phases such as Checkout and Commissioning, In-Orbit Verification and anomaly response.
Lead and contribute to anomaly investigations, root cause analyses, and failure review boards, ensuring findings are well-documented and lessons are captured.
Ensure the mission impact of anomalies is assessed and operational workarounds, corrective actions and recovery steps are appropriate.
Identify links between incidents and coordinate response to common anomalies across the fleet.
Ensure lessons learned are fed back to satellite development teams using non-conformance and corrective action processes.
Liaise with software development, systems engineering and satellite operations teams to continually improve satellite operations tooling, improving Fault Detection, Isolation and Recovery (FDIR), increasing automation and raising the availability of the satellite fleet through transition to AI/ML based systems.
Serve as the mission assurance interface to the operations team, software engineers, and systems engineers during anomaly investigations and resolution.

BSc or MEng in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
3+ years of experience in a software QA, systems engineering, or mission assurance role within a highly regulated industry (e.g. aerospace, defence, banking, medical).
Proven track record of contributing to investigations and fault finding of complex systems.
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g. Git) and issue tracking tools.
Understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile and/or waterfall) and associated QA activities.
Clear and concise communicator, able to present technical findings to diverse audiences including management and non-specialist stakeholders.

Experience working with FMEA, FDIR, hazard analysis, or other dependability and safety analysis methods.
Experience with satellite operations or ground segment software in an operational environment.
Experience supporting LEOP, commissioning, or in-orbit validation activities.
Proficiency in scripting or data analysis for telemetry analysis.
Background in configuration management in a regulated engineering environment.
Experience with failure review boards or anomaly resolution in an operational setting.
Knowledge of relevant standards such as ISO 29110, ECSS-Q-ST-80, ECSS-E-ST-40, or DO-178C.

We are looking for a highly skilled QA Analyst who excels in manual test execution, exploratory testing, and end-to-end validation of business requirements. Translate requirements into well-structured test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.
Validate that delivered features meet business expectations, regulatory constraints, and user experience goals.

Perform exploratory, context-driven testing to uncover edge cases beyond scripted scenarios.

Validate workflows end-to-end to ensure consistency across services and distributed systems.

Help teams identify quality risks early (shift-left mindset).
Support cross-team quality initiatives aimed at improving test processes, documentation standards, and release confidence.
Assist in shaping acceptance criteria, test charters, and exploratory testing sessions.

Maintain clear test cases, checklists, exploratory notes, and traceability to requirements.
Provide timely test summaries and risk assessments for release decisions.

3+ years in manual testing, business validation, or quality assurance.
Strong command of exploratory testing techniques (session-based, charter-based, heuristics).
Experience designing and executing manual tests for Web, Mobile, APIs ecosystems.
Ability to decompose complex requirements and identify logical test paths, dependencies, and risk areas.
Familiarity with Agile and DevOps environments (Scrum, Kanban, CI/CD workflows).
Competence with QA management and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
Strong defect investigation and root-cause communication skills.
Nice-to-Have Skills

Understanding of observability concepts (logs, metrics, traces) for issue investigation.
Knowledge of BDD-style acceptance criteria (Gherkin) for business alignment.
Soft Skills & Cultural Fit
Sharp analytical and problem-solving abilities with a user-centric mindset.
Excellent communication across multidisciplinary teams.
Curious, investigative mindset—comfortable testing beyond the “happy path.”
Ownership mentality and commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.
Continuous learner driven by improving processes and discovering better ways to test.

Work on diverse, high-impact projects across industries.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.
You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.
Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.
Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

s.h: About the role — DFYNE Your Career
s.t:
Before I tell you more about the role, let me introduce myself. I’m Bruce, Head of Development at DFYNE, and I’m looking for our first dedicated Senior QA Automation Engineer. This is a hands-on engineering role that will help define quality engineering across DFYNE.

Reporting directly to the Head of Development, you will work alongside our Staff Software Engineer to build the test infrastructure, automation coverage and quality gates that allow our teams to move quickly without compromising reliability.

You will help protect systems that handle commission payouts, refunds, inventory synchronisation, shipping labels and other business-critical processes where quality has a direct commercial impact.

· Ownership mentality

· Engineering-first approach

· Attention to detail

· Risk-based thinking

· Continuous improvement

· Build and maintain integration test infrastructure that runs against real databases and realistic service environments.

· Design and implement automated regression coverage across business-critical workflows.

· Own CI quality gates and contribute to release readiness processes.

· Develop end-to-end testing coverage for revenue-critical customer journeys.

· Create and maintain realistic and secure test data strategies.

· Work closely with engineers to identify and prevent quality risks early in the development lifecycle.

· Improve test reliability, execution speed and developer adoption.

· Support incident investigations by identifying testing gaps and opportunities for preventative coverage.

· Contribute to engineering standards, software quality practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

· Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Operations teams to ensure quality requirements are understood and delivered.

· 5+ years of experience in QA Automation, SDET or software engineering with a quality focus.

· Strong TypeScript or Python development experience.

· Deep integration testing experience using real dependencies including databases, queues and simulated third-party services.

· Strong Playwright, Cypress or equivalent end-to-end testing experience.

· Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD quality gates, ideally using GitHub Actions.

· Strong understanding of automated testing strategies and risk-based testing approaches.

· Experience building scalable, maintainable test frameworks.

· Ability to write production-quality code.

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

· Strong problem-solving and analytical capability.

· E-commerce or payments experience.

· Contract testing experience.

· Performance and load testing experience.

· Google Cloud Platform familiarity.

· Terraform and Infrastructure as Code experience.

s.h: So, what’s in it for you?
s.t:
If you’ve made it this far down without being put off, brilliant. I’d genuinely love to hear from you. Beyond joining a work family and a genuinely great place to build your career, you’ll become DFYNE’s first dedicated quality engineering hire and help define how quality is delivered across one of the UK’s fastest-growing companies. You’ll build systems and processes that have a visible impact on reliability, customer experience and business performance.
You’ll be part of a high challenge; high reward culture.

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our current QA team. You'll take ownership of how we test, validate, and sign off on quality across our platform. We're actively investing in our QA practice: expanding automated test coverage, improving our release testing process, and moving toward a model where quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle.
You'll report to a technical Engineering Manager and work alongside engineers who value clear test documentation, reliable automation, and confident code releases.
As a mature company, we have legacy systems and established manual testing workflows, but we are transitioning to modern automated testing practices using Playwright and TypeScript. The split between manual and automated work varies, but you should be comfortable working across both, bringing automation where it adds the most value while pragmatically maintaining manual coverage where it's still the right tool.
A core goal of our QA evolution is to make testing faster, more reliable, and less dependent on last-minute changes before each release: replacing fragile manual regression cycles with stable automated suites, reducing flakiness, and building coverage that the whole team can rely on. Every testing investment is measured by whether it improves quality and reduces the team's burden at release time.

Write and maintain automated regression tests; review automation MRs from peers
Execute manual testing across web UIs (functional, regression, cross-platform, responsive layouts on mobile/tablet)
Create and maintain test cases, checklists, and test documentation in TestRail
File clear, actionable bug reports with reproduction steps; collaborate with developers to triage and resolve
Own the release testing process to ensure only high-quality changes ship
Partner with PMs and designers on requirements review, edge cases, and acceptance criteria
Contribute to QA process improvements as we scale (currently a 2-person team growing to 4)
How We Work
We believe you should know what your days look like before you accept an offer.
We don't have much bureaucracy. Small team, direct communication, short decision loops. If you've worked at places where opening a Jira ticket to request a Jira ticket was normal, this isn't that. Here's the reality:

Daily standup with your product team. Show up, share updates and unblock each other..
Sprint planning and retrospectives with your product team, once per sprint.
1:1 with your Engineering Manager - Regular cadence, your agenda.
Monthly Engineering all-hands.
That's it. The rest of your time is yours to work.

Bi-monthly release cadence with a schedule published in advance. As a QA Engineer, you own the release testing window. Coordinating with developers, running regression suites, and signing off on quality before the release.
Infrequent ad-hoc hotfixes

Async-friendly. Documentation-first.

Bei Alstom bauen wir, worauf Millionen täglich angewiesen sind - Bahnsysteme, die nicht versagen dürfen. Wir sind mehr als 85.000 Menschen weltweit und schaffen das vielfältigste Portfolio der Branche: Hochgeschwindigkeitszüge, Metros, Straßenbahnen, Wartungsservices und integrierte Systeme.
### Mehr als ein Job: Eine Mission ###
Wir suchen eine leidenschaftliche Persönlichkeit, die innovative Lösungen im Bereich Traktion entwickelt und testet. Sie arbeiten mit engagierten Teams zusammen, um die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mitzugestalten und nachhaltige Technologien voranzutreiben.
### Ihre Rolle, Ihr Einfluss ###
* Entwicklung und Durchführung skalierbarer Teststrategien für Traktionssysteme, um höchste Zuverlässigkeit im Flottenbetrieb zu gewährleisten
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams aus Engineering, Produktion und Qualitätssicherung zur Optimierung von Testprozessen
* Analyse und Sicherstellung der Systemzuverlässigkeit durch präzise Fehlerdiagnose und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Testmethoden
* Einbringen neuer Ideen und Technologien zur Steigerung der Innovationskraft im Bereich Bahntechnik
* Weitergabe von Fachwissen durch Schulungen und Mentoring innerhalb des Teams
Sie arbeiten mit engagierten, kompetenten Teams an komplexen Herausforderungen, die die Zukunft der Mobilität prägen und eine nahtlose Integration von Business und Technologie sicherstellen.
### Was Sie mitbringen ###
* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder vergleichbar
* Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Bahntechnik, Testengineering oder verwandten Feldern
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Testautomatisierung, Leistungselektronik und Bahnnormen
* Verständnis für sicherheitskritische Systeme, Fehleranalyse und Validierungsmethoden
* Teamfähigkeit, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
### Wie Erfolg gemessen wird ###
* Einhaltung von Lieferterminen und Erreichung strategischer Projektziele
* Effektive Zusammenarbeit und Führung innerhalb des Testteams
* Reduktion von Fehlern und Steigerung der Testeffizienz durch kontinuierliche Optimierung
### Alstom, ein großartiger Ort für Ihre Entwicklung ###
* Einsatz modernster Technologien und klare strategische Ausrichtung auf nachhaltige Mobilität
* Globale Wirkung durch innovative Projekte am Standort Zürich
* Karriereentwicklung durch kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Wissenstransfer
Hier ist Fortschritt nicht immer einfach, aber die Wirkung ist spürbar. Denn der Maßstab ist groß, die Aufgaben sind komplex - wenn das System läuft, der Zug fährt und die Stadt verbunden ist, bleibt dieses Gefühl. Und das Vermächtnis bleibt bestehen.

Role Purpose
Integrated Supply Chain organization is seeking a dedicated Data Analyst to support the Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) function. This role will focus on supplier quality digitization, analytics, and visualization , enabling data‑driven decision‑making across SQE leadership and stakeholders.
The Data Analyst will work closely with the Supplier Quality Engineering organization and existing digitization teams to understand current workflows, automate data pipelines, and deliver interactive dashboards and ad‑hoc insights that improve supplier quality performance, risk visibility, and operational effectiveness.

1. Dashboard & Analytics Development
Build and maintain visual dashboards that provide clear, actionable insights into supplier quality performance, risks, trends, and corrective action effectiveness.
Translate complex, multi‑source datasets into intuitive, decision‑ready visualizations for SQE leadership and stakeholders.
2. Digitization & Workflow Alignment
Work closely with the current SQE digitization team to understand existing data flows, reporting workflows, and analytics requirements.
Align new analytics solutions with established SQE processes, standards, and governance models.
3. Data Pipelines & Automation
Develop, maintain, and automate data pipelines and workflows for Supplier Quality Engineering using Alteryx (or equivalent ETL tools) .
Ensure data accuracy, repeatability, scalability, and timely refresh of SQE analytics.
Document data flows, transformations, and KPI definitions to support standardization and continuity.
4. Interactive Visualization & Reporting
Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, React‑based dashboards, or equivalent tools .
Create analytics that support supplier quality decision‑making, including performance monitoring, risk identification, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Optimize dashboards for usability, performance, and stakeholder adoption.
5. Ad‑hoc Analysis & Executive Support
Perform ad‑hoc data analysis to support SQE initiatives, leadership requests, and supplier reviews.
Present findings, trends, and insights to SQE stakeholders and leadership in a clear, concise, and business‑focused manner.
Support governance reviews, operational reviews, and continuous improvement discussions with data‑backed insights.

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field .
Hands‑on experience with Alteryx or comparable ETL/data preparation tools for workflow automation and analytics enablement.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau and/or Power BI (experience with React‑based dashboards is a plus).
Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple systems.
Strong problem‑solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills , with the ability to translate data into meaningful business insights.

Experience supporting Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or Supply Chain organizations.
Familiarity with quality metrics, corrective actions, audits, and supplier performance management.
Experience in aerospace, industrial, or regulated manufacturing environments .
Exposure to ERP and quality management systems

We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.
WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.
The Impact You Will Have
As a Senior QA Engineer, you will help shape the future of our Loan Origination and Servicing platform — ensuring the quality, reliability, and trustworthiness of systems that power complex financial decisions.

You will embed a critical-thinking, automation-first mindset into our development process, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to identify risks early and define meaningful quality standards. Your work will extend beyond defect detection — you will help build a culture where quality is engineered from the start.

Analyze functional and technical requirements to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and risks early in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
Develop a deep understanding of business objectives and user journeys to validate that solutions meet real-world needs.
Design and execute comprehensive testing strategies, including functional, automated, integration, and regression testing.
Implement scalable automated testing frameworks and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable releases.
Define, track, and evolve clear quality metrics that promote transparency and continuous improvement.
Communicate actionable quality insights to Engineering, Product Management, and business stakeholders to support data-driven decisions.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate testing tools and approaches based on scalability and long-term maintainability.

6+ years of experience in software quality engineering or software development.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Experience building and maintaining automated UI and API test frameworks and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines.
Strong understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies.
Experience in real estate finance or financial services preferred.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Strong knowledge of business-driven and risk-based testing methodologies, with the ability to prioritize testing efforts based on impact and risk.
Proficiency in UI and API testing approaches, including modern automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Postman).
Working knowledge of SQL and client-side technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Strong understanding of testing strategies across unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end levels.
Ability to leverage AI-enabled tools to enhance test design, automation, and documentation.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to surface issues proactively.
High degree of ownership and accountability, with a commitment to continuous improvement.
Collaborative mindset grounded in professionalism, respect, and thoughtful partnership.
Ability to work independently, provide early feedback, and adapt to evolving priorities in an Agile environment.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes.
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders.
